transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I came because my family and friends keep telling me the bank papers show nothing was taken, but I know they’re hiding my money. It’s been going on for over a year. They use bills, fundraisers, and these trip plans to cover it up, and I keep having to confront them because nobody will just tell me the truth.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?
No, I haven’t noticed hearing voices or sounds that other people don’t hear.
Over this past year, have you been feeling persistently down, depressed, or hopeless?
I’m not sure. I’ve been upset about everything, but I wouldn’t say I’ve felt hopeless.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually energized or on top of the world, needing much less sleep than usual?
I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed times where I needed a lot less sleep or felt unusually energized.
Do you have any chronic medical conditions, or have you ever had any serious neurological problems or head injuries?
I don’t know of any chronic medical problems. And I haven’t had any serious head injuries or neurological issues that I know of.
Have you ever felt like an outside force was controlling your thoughts or body?
No, I haven’t felt like something else was controlling my thoughts or my body.
